_comment: Sources for the Live Drug Underworld Map wire. Three blocks. 'editions' are Google News country editions — each is read in its own language using the query set named by its lang, and an item from an edition falls back to that country when nothing in the text geo-tags it. 'searches' are global queries not tied to a country. 'feeds' are read directly; 'trusted' marks a publication whose whole output is on subject, which lowers the score an item from it needs to clear. Google News ANDs every bare word in a query, so every query here is written as parenthesised OR groups — one illicit-economy group, one capture group. The first build used flat five-word strings, which is why it returned eight items.
